question:
Simplify the following.

 5¹⁵ div 25⁽¹³⁾/⁽²⁾ div 125⁽²⁾/⁽³⁾ + 5¹⁷ div 125⁽¹⁶⁾/⁽³⁾ + 5³
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert all bases into 5: 25 = 5², 125 = 5³

Expression becomes powers of 5 → subtract exponents directly

First term: 5¹⁵ ÷ 5¹³ ÷ 5² = 5⁰ = 1

Second term: 5¹⁷ ÷ 5¹⁶ = 5

Third term = 125

Total = 1 + 5 + 125 = 131

**∴ Answer = 131**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

5¹⁵ ÷ 25¹³/² ÷ 125²/³ + 5¹⁷ ÷ 125¹⁶/³ + 5³

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS rule

**Calculation:**

⇒ 5¹⁵ ÷ (5²)¹³/² ÷ (5³)²/³ + 5¹⁷ ÷ (5³)¹⁶/³ + 5³

⇒ 5¹⁵ ÷ 5¹³ ÷ 5² + 5¹⁷ ÷ 5¹⁶ + 5³

⇒ 5¹⁵−¹³ ÷ 5² + 5¹ + 5³

⇒ 5² ÷ 5² + 5 + 125

⇒ 5⁰ + 5 + 125

⇒ 1 + 5 + 125

⇒ 131

**∴ The correct answer is 131.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Brackets, Orders (powers), Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.

Laws of Exponents

am ÷ aⁿ = am−ⁿ

Power of a Power

(am)ⁿ = amⁿ

Zero Power Rule

a⁰ = 1 (a ≠ 0)
